title.suggested: Referee Al Smith Recalled for Mace-Allen Fight

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch, profiling referee "Al" Smith, quoted Billy Harding that Smith first refereed in May 1870, at the fight between Jem Mace of England and Tom Allen of America for $2,000 and the world championship.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Friday Evening, November 18, 1892, page 10

facts.fact: Allen, as champion of America, fought Jem Mace, champion of England, in May 1870 for $2,000 and the championship of the world, with "Al" Smith as referee

notes: Recollection by Billy Harding 22 years later; the $2,000 stake differs from other accounts ($2,500 or $5,000 a side). Recrop to include the item's start at the foot of column 2.
